text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold positions at gains, but a gain versus my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should judge each holding by its prospects and role in the portfolio.","Selling winners while holding or later rebuying stocks can reflect loss aversion and regret avoidance. I should set consistent, forward-looking rules rather than anchor on my purchase price.","These trades did not reveal a reliable pattern in random price movements. I should avoid reacting to short-term changes, keep diversification and risk in mind, and trade only when my plan warrants it."]}
